messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action so that they stand in a thoughtful pose, following the movement shown in the motion reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to the version produced by the first clothing change, then apply the following change to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they stand in a thoughtful pose, as shown in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands mostly still, then turns his head and body to the side, raises a hand to his chin, and shifts his weight before returning to a forward-facing stance.","camera":"A static, eye-level full-body shot keeps the character centered against the city backdrop.","clothing":"He wears a white long-sleeved collared shirt under a dark sleeveless vest, red flared trousers, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Light brown or dark blond.","hairstyle":"Short, cropped hair with a slightly spiky or textured top.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build and light skin stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"The setting is a stylized urban plaza with tiled pavement, tall buildings, construction cranes, and illuminated storefront signs with Japanese text."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character now turns to the side, raises a hand to the chin, crosses the other arm, shifts weight, and returns to a forward stance, matching the reference's thoughtful motion. Clothing, hair, face, urban scene, and static camera remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to a thoughtful pose following the motion reference, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Exact fidelity of the motion timing to the reference video could not be verified frame by frame.
